To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Y75N mutant MP-1 has been overexpresssed in yeast, purified, and cocrystallsized with the iodinated human renin inhibitor, CP-113972.

the Y75N variant of the aspartic protease Mucor pusilus pepsin, when complexed with the renin inhibitor CP113972, forms tetragonal crystals with space group symmetry P4(3),2(1),2, and unit-cell parameters a=b=182.5, and c=99.1 A, which diffract X-rays to 3.2 A resolution.
the structure of the Y75 mutant Mucor pustilus pepsin complex with the iodinecontaining human renin inhibitor has been determined.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new methods for the production of recombinant proteins in yeast and the subsequent structural analysis of the proteins produced.
the development of a new generation of inhibitors for renin, a key enzyme in the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system.
the structural and functional analysis of the Y(75)N mutant of M. pusillus (MPP) pepsin complex with human renin inhibitor (CP-113972).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the X-ray structure of Y75 mutant M. pusilus pepsin is being determined and will be published in due course.
the structure of the mutant enzyme has been solved and the structure of the complex with the inhibitor is under way.
the Y75N M. pusillus PEP mutant is an excellent model for the study of the structure and function of the catalytic site of pepsins.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we were able to produce crystals of the Y75 mutant M. pusilus pepsin in complex with a renin inhibitor, which diffract to a resolution of 3.0A.
we have produced a mutant of M. pusillus that is amenable to crystallization and that we have produced crystals of this mutant complexed with an iodine-containing inhibitor.
the Y75N mutation in the M. pusillus protease is a useful model for the development of new inhibitors of human pepsin.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to obtain good quality crystals for the Y75N M. pusillus mutant with inhibitor bound.

the Y75N mutation in Mucor pusillius pepsin does not alter its structure significantly, which is in contrast to the results of the X-ray analysis of a Y75N mutant in human pepsin, which revealed a large structural change in this mutant.
